name: Symbolism
summary: Pictures of dream, myth, death and desire, in which a figure or a form stands for an idea. The mood is quiet, strange and inward; line and colour are chosen to suggest, never to explain.

philosophy.core_thesis: A picture should suggest an inner idea by symbol and mood, and should turn from the plain surface of the visible world toward dream and the spirit.
design_principles: Show an idea by an image: a sphinx, a flower with a face, a floating head, a veiled woman, a dark pool.
Keep the space shallow and still, with a flat, decorative field of 40–60% behind the main figure.
Set the figure in the centre or on a clear axis, and hold it motionless, with a closed or far-off gaze.
Use a limited, dim, jewel-like palette: violet, deep blue, gold and green, with pale flesh and a dark ground.
Draw a long, soft, flowing line of 2–6mm and let the contour curve like a stem or a hair.
Blur the edges in mist and dusk, and blend the light into a glow without a source.
Leave one thing unexplained: a title, a gaze, or an object that has no place in the scene.
anti_patterns: A plain, literal record of daily life
Harsh, bright daylight with strong cast shadows
Fast, loud, active strokes and a busy crowd
A clear story that the title explains in full
A deep, open landscape with a wide horizon

composition.layout: A still, frontal figure or head on a central axis, against a shallow, flat or misty field, with a curving contour and a few symbolic objects.
composition.focal_point: The face or the eye, in the upper half of the picture at 33–45% from the top, on the central axis or one third from an edge.
composition.format: A vertical canvas or panel at 3:4 to 1:2; a small to medium size of 0.3 to 1.2m; a tall format gives a frieze-like calm.

principles.rule: Hold the main figure on a central vertical axis, with a deviation of less than 5% of the picture width.
Keep 40–60% of the picture as a quiet, dim field of one hue around the figure.
Reduce the depth to 2 layers: a near figure and a flat or misty ground, with no deep horizon.
Place the eye or the face at 33–45% from the top, and make it the only area with a value jump of 30% or more.
Repeat a soft curve of a stem, a hair or a wave 3–6 times, at a step of 10–20% of the picture width.
Spend 70–80% of the area on 2 dim hues of violet, blue or green, and 5–10% on a gold or pale accent.

palette.strategy: A dim, jewel-like key: violet, deep blue and green, lit by pale flesh and a small amount of gold; the ground is dark or misted.
palette.distribution: Dim hue ground 50–60%, mid-tone dress and plants 20–30%, pale flesh and light 10–15%, gold accent 5%.
palette.ground: A dark, warm ground or a gold leaf field; thin glazes over it.

colours.name: Rose dusk
colours.role: flower, cloth and a warm mist

brushwork_and_medium.medium: Oil and tempera in thin, matt layers; pastel and watercolour for dream scenes.
brushwork_and_medium.support: Fine canvas, panel or paper with a smooth ground.
brushwork_and_medium.brushwork: Fine, soft strokes of 1–3mm, blended; a flowing contour line of 2–6mm; no loud touch.
brushwork_and_medium.paint_handling: 4–8 thin glazes; the surface is smooth and the colour glows from below; gold leaf in places.
brushwork_and_medium.edges: Soft and lost at the hair, the mist and the far field; a clear, curving contour at the face and the hand.

light_and_modelling.light: A dim, even glow with no clear source, like dusk, a lamp or moonlight; the face holds the highest value.
light_and_modelling.modelling: Gentle, in 4–6 steps; the face is smooth and pale, with a dark eye.
light_and_modelling.shadow: Deep and soft, 40–60% of the area, in violet or blue; no hard cast edge.
light_and_modelling.temperature: A cool, dim key with a small warm gold or rose glow around the face.

subject.typical: A sphinx, a muse, a head on a plate, a veiled woman, a dream flower, a dark lake, a myth, a vision and a death-watch.
subject.figure_scale: A head or a figure fills 40–70% of the picture height, close and still.
subject.treatment: Hushed, strange and inward; the image suggests a meaning and gives no key.

surface.finish: Matt and soft, with an even, velvet look.
surface.texture: Smooth, with a faint grain; gold leaf or a thin gilt line in places.

reference_works.note: Object ids were checked against the Art Institute of Chicago API (CC0 data). Look at the museum page for the image and its licence.

emotion.target_response: Quiet unease and wonder: the viewer feels a dream that holds a meaning and does not give it.

use_cases: perfume, tea and jewellery campaign art
music and theatre posters with a dream mood
editorial art on inner life and myth
avoid_when: The brief needs a bright, clear, literal or technical image.
The picture must be loud, fast or playful.

modifiers.how: Drop the symbol and the mist; use a plain brown key, ordinary people at work, and one light from the side.
Keep the dream; move it into a clear, deep plain with exact detail, a long shadow and an object at 3 to 10 times its true size.
